summary_ja: 勘定間の振替に関する方針（制限内容・変更要件・取締役会承認手続・例外的事象の特定方法・開示方法）を策定し、年1回以上見直すことを義務付ける条文。
summary_en: Requires Ultimate Designated Parent Companies, etc. to formulate and annually review policies on transfers between accounts covering restrictions, requirements for changes, board approval procedures, identification of exceptional events, and disclosure methods.
